en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a grand brick railway station complex with ornate facades, arched windows, and a central entrance pavilion topped by steep roofs and small towers. The words "Pécs" and "Indóház" are printed on the image side. The reverse side has Hungarian handwritten text, a green postage stamp labeled "MAGYAR KIR. POSTA 5 FILLER," postmarks, and the printed heading "LEVELEZŐ-LAP."
